craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Warrant claimed plainly; told-plain close seals passage 1 (statable-in-recognition). Rejected: (a) heightening warrant → killed: plainness is the claim. (b) path→way → killed: mārga-path load consistency. Read aloud: SO-ev-en IN-this-SHIN-ing … STAT-a-ble TOO, TOLD-plain ON re-cog-NI-tion's-PATH.

lines: So even in this shining, the many's unity-seeing finds warrant —
statable too, told plain on recognition's path.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthamābhāsa evāsminnanekasyaikatādṛśi vācyopapattiḥ sāpyuktā pratyabhijñānaye sphuṭam

reads_against.argmap: Can this justification be stated? → Warrant claimed: the many-seen-as-one is statable inside the Pratyabhijñā, plainly.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
